task: Keep local queue review operational after the fixture server has been running longer than the allowance snapshot freshness window.
nonGoals: Production changes, live provider calls, password changes, changes to allowance validation, reservation limits, or cache behavior.

outcomes.description: An authenticated local submission after fixture evidence would have expired is accepted and runs through persisted queue progress to a report.
outcomes.evidence: Clock-controlled queue integration regression after the five-minute window and across a UTC day/month boundary.

process.description: Commit the corrective plan before implementation and update the existing feature PR with source-bound evidence.
process.evidence: Git history, evaluation, local container verification and independent review.

styleEfficiency.description: Refresh synthetic metrics at the fixture boundary and reuse the existing test guard, caps and ledger.
styleEfficiency.evidence: Scoped diff and queue integration tests.

exitTest.reason: This corrects fixture input timestamps and adds a runtime regression, with no agent workflow or portability changes.
